welcome.text: Welcome to the Command Autofix feature demonstration. This powerful tool automatically detects and resolves build and compilation issues across your entire project.

open_project_view.text: Let's start by opening our project view. We'll be working with a sample project that has some build issues to fix.

select_directory.text: We'll select the project root directory to analyze the entire codebase. Command Autofix works recursively through all project files.

access_menu.text: Now we'll access the Auto-Fix feature through the AI Coder menu.

navigate_agents.text: Navigate to the Agents submenu, where you'll find various automated assistance tools.

configure_settings.text: Let's configure the Command Autofix settings. The tool offers several options to customize how fixes are applied.

copy_gradlew_path.text: First, we need to copy the path to our Gradle wrapper executable. This tells Command Autofix which build tool to use.

configure_tool_selection.text: Now we'll paste the gradlew path into the tool selection field. This specifies the exact build command that Command Autofix will use.

configure_tool_arguments.text: Next, we'll add 'clean build' as the tool execution arguments. This ensures a clean build process that will reveal any compilation issues.

enable_auto_apply.text: We'll enable the 'Auto-apply fixes' option, which allows Command Autofix to automatically implement suggested fixes without manual confirmation.

browser_interface.text: The Command Autofix interface opens in your browser, providing a detailed view of the analysis process and any fixes being applied.

analysis_process.text: Watch as Command Autofix analyzes your build output, identifies issues, and applies appropriate fixes. The AI considers your project's context and build configuration.

success_completion.text: Excellent! Command Autofix has successfully resolved the build issues. Notice how the build now completes without errors, demonstrating the effectiveness of the automated fixes.

retry_attempts.text: Sometimes multiple attempts may be needed for complex issues. Command Autofix will automatically retry with different approaches until the build succeeds.

troubleshooting.text: If you encounter any issues accessing the interface, ensure your IDE has permission to open browser windows.

demo_conclusion.text: And that concludes our demonstration of Command Autofix. This powerful feature saves time by automatically resolving build issues, allowing you to focus on writing code rather than fixing build problems.
